import sys

sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1])

import logsummary

LINES = [
    "2026-11-01T00:00:01 ERROR billing charge failed for 17",
    "2026-11-01T00:00:02 WARNING billing slow response",
    "2026-11-01T00:00:03 ERROR auth token expired",
    "2026-11-01T00:00:04 INFO auth login ok",
    "2026-11-01T00:00:05 ERROR billing charge failed for 18",
    "2026-11-01T00:00:06 ERROR billing charge failed for 19",
    "2026-11-01T00:00:07 ERROR billing charge failed for 20",
    "2026-11-01T00:00:08 WARNING search index stale",
]
records = [logsummary.parse_record(line) for line in LINES]
print(logsummary.summarize_errors(records))
print(logsummary.summarize_warnings(records))
print(logsummary.summarize_errors([]))
print(logsummary.summarize_warnings([r for r in records if r["level"] == "INFO"]))
assert logsummary.summarize_errors(records).startswith("5 ERROR records")
assert logsummary.summarize_warnings(records).startswith("2 WARNING records")
print("ok")
